id-20260827-intro-agriculture-8.title: [Agronomy #8] Why Is Today's Rice Different from Our Grandparents' Rice? The Secret of Plant Breeding

segments.src: > Varietas unggul bukan muncul begitu saja: ia hasil kerja bertahun-tahun menyilangkan, menyeleksi, dan menjaga koleksi benih lama agar keragaman genetiknya tidak punah.
segments.tr: > Superior varieties do not just appear out of nowhere: they are the result of years of work crossing, selecting, and maintaining old seed collections so that their genetic diversity does not go extinct.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Coba bandingkan padi yang ditanam kakek-nenek kita di tahun 1960-an dengan padi di sawah sekarang.
segments.tr: Try comparing the rice grown by our grandparents in the 1960s with the rice in the fields today.

segments.src: Yang dulu batangnya tinggi, mudah rebah kalau kena angin, dan panen sekali butuh 5–6 bulan.
segments.tr: The old ones had tall stalks, easily lodged when hit by wind, and harvesting once took 5–6 months.

segments.src: Yang sekarang batangnya pendek, tegak, dan bisa dipanen sekitar 3–4 bulan.
segments.tr: The current ones have short stalks, upright, and can be harvested in about 3–4 months.

segments.src: Perubahan itu bukan kebetulan alam — itu hasil **pemuliaan tanaman** (*plant breeding*).
segments.tr: That change is not a natural coincidence — it is the result of **plant breeding** (*plant breeding*).

segments.src: Pemuliaan tanaman adalah usaha manusia mengubah susunan genetik tanaman supaya sifatnya lebih sesuai dengan kebutuhan kita: lebih banyak hasil, lebih tahan hama, lebih tahan kekeringan, atau rasanya lebih enak.
segments.tr: Plant breeding is human effort to alter the genetic makeup of plants so that their traits better match our needs: higher yield, more pest resistance, more drought resistance, or better taste.

segments.src: Prinsip dasarnya cuma dua langkah yang diulang terus:
segments.tr: The basic principle is just two steps repeated continuously:

segments.src: Ciptakan keragaman.** Kalau semua tanaman di lahan sifatnya sama persis, tidak ada yang bisa dipilih.
segments.tr: Create diversity.** If all plants in a field have the exact same traits, nothing can be selected.

segments.src: Jadi pemulia harus dulu "mengaduk" gen.
segments.tr: So the breeder must first "stir" the genes.

segments.src: Cara paling umum adalah **persilangan (hibridisasi)**: serbuk sari dari tanaman A ditempelkan ke putik tanaman B.
segments.tr: The most common method is **crossing (hybridization)**: pollen from plant A is placed onto the stigma of plant B.

segments.src: Misal, A hasilnya melimpah tapi gampang kena wereng; B hasilnya sedang tapi tahan wereng.
segments.tr: For example, A has abundant yield but is easily attacked by planthoppers; B has moderate yield but is resistant to planthoppers.

segments.src: Anak-anaknya akan punya kombinasi gen campuran — sebagian mewarisi paket yang kita mau.
segments.tr: The offspring will have a mixed gene combination — some inheriting the package we want.

segments.src: Pilih yang terbaik.** Ini disebut **seleksi**.
segments.tr: Choose the best.** This is called **selection**.

segments.src: Dari ribuan tanaman keturunan, pemulia menanam, mengamati, mengukur, lalu menyimpan benih dari yang paling bagus dan membuang sisanya.
segments.tr: From thousands of descendant plants, the breeder grows, observes, measures, then saves the seeds from the very best ones and discards the rest.

segments.src: Generasi berikutnya diulangi lagi.
segments.tr: The next generation is repeated again.

segments.src: Setelah 6–10 generasi, sifat yang diinginkan sudah "mantap" (stabil dan seragam) — barulah calon varietas itu diuji di banyak lokasi dan didaftarkan sebagai varietas resmi.
segments.tr: After 6–10 generations, the desired traits are "fixed" (stable and uniform) — only then is the prospective variety tested in many locations and registered as an official variety.

segments.src: Kalau keragamannya sudah ada secara alami di populasi lokal — misalnya di satu desa ada banyak tipe padi lokal bercampur — pemulia bisa langsung lompat ke langkah 2 saja.
segments.tr: If the diversity already exists naturally in the local population — for example, in a village there are many mixed local rice types — the breeder can directly jump to step 2 only.

segments.src: Ini yang disebut **seleksi murni** atau pemuliaan seleksi: tidak menyilangkan apa-apa, hanya memilah yang terbaik dari yang sudah ada.
segments.tr: This is called **pure line selection** or selection breeding: not crossing anything, just sorting out the best from what already exists.

segments.src: Banyak varietas lokal Indonesia yang "dibersihkan" dengan cara ini.
segments.tr: Many Indonesian local varieties are "cleaned up" in this way.

segments.src: Ada satu hal penting yang sering terlupakan: **bahan bakunya harus tersedia.** Pemulia tidak bisa menciptakan gen dari nol.
segments.tr: There is one important thing that is often forgotten: **the raw materials must be available.** Breeders cannot create genes from scratch.

segments.src: Kalau tidak ada satu pun padi di dunia yang membawa gen tahan penyakit X, tidak ada yang bisa disilangkan.
segments.tr: If not a single rice in the world carries the disease resistance gene X, nothing can be crossed.

segments.src: Maka lahirlah **konservasi sumber daya genetik (plasma nutfah)** — usaha menyimpan dan menjaga benih varietas lama, varietas lokal, bahkan kerabat liar tanaman budidaya.
segments.tr: Thus was born **genetic resource conservation (germplasm)** — the effort to store and protect seeds of old varieties, local varieties, and even wild relatives of cultivated crops.

segments.src: Ada dua model:
segments.tr: There are two models:

segments.src: - **Konservasi ex situ**: disimpan di luar habitat aslinya, biasanya di bank gen — ruangan dingin (sekitar -18 °C) berisi ribuan sampel benih. Indonesia punya koleksi plasma nutfah yang dikelola BRIN dan Kementerian Pertanian; di tingkat dunia ada bank benih global di Svalbard, Norwegia.
segments.tr: - **Ex situ conservation**: stored outside their natural habitat, usually in a gene bank — a cold room (around -18 °C) containing thousands of seed samples. Indonesia has a germplasm collection managed by BRIN and the Ministry of Agriculture; at the global level there is the global seed vault in Svalbard, Norway.

segments.src: - **Konservasi in situ / on-farm**: dijaga di tempat asalnya, termasuk ketika petani terus menanam varietas lokal warisan di lahannya sendiri. Petani yang masih menanam padi lokal seperti Rojolele, Pandanwangi, atau Mentik Wangi sebenarnya sedang ikut menjaga koleksi genetik nasional.
segments.tr: - **In situ / on-farm conservation**: kept in their place of origin, including when farmers continue to grow heritage local varieties on their own land. Farmers who still grow local rice like Rojolele, Pandanwangi, or Mentik Wangi are actually participating in maintaining the national genetic collection.

segments.src: Kenapa ini genting?
segments.tr: Why is this critical?

segments.src: Karena ketika semua petani beralih ke satu-dua varietas unggul yang sama, keragaman di lapangan menyusut.
segments.tr: Because when all farmers switch to the same one or two superior varieties, diversity in the field shrinks.

segments.src: Ini disebut **erosi genetik**.
segments.tr: This is called **genetic erosion**.

segments.src: Kalau lalu muncul hama atau penyakit baru yang kebetulan cocok menyerang varietas dominan itu, kerugiannya bisa serentak di mana-mana.
segments.tr: If a new pest or disease suddenly appears that happens to suit attacking that dominant variety, the losses can be simultaneous everywhere.

segments.src: Koleksi plasma nutfah adalah "asuransi" untuk skenario itu.
segments.tr: Germplasm collections are "insurance" for that scenario.

segments.src: Satu istilah lagi yang sering terdengar: **varietas hibrida**.
segments.tr: One more term often heard: **hybrid variety**.

segments.src: Ini adalah keturunan generasi pertama (F1) dari persilangan dua galur murni, dan hasilnya sering lebih tinggi daripada kedua induknya — fenomena ini disebut **heterosis** atau *hybrid vigor*.
segments.tr: This is the first generation (F1) offspring from crossing two pure lines, and the result is often higher than both parents — this phenomenon is called **heterosis** or *hybrid vigor*.

segments.src: Tapi ada konsekuensinya: benih hasil panen dari tanaman hibrida tidak bisa ditanam ulang dengan hasil yang sama, karena di generasi kedua sifatnya sudah terpecah-pecah.
segments.tr: But there is a consequence: harvest seeds from hybrid plants cannot be replanted with the same result, because in the second generation the traits have broken apart.

segments.src: Itulah alasan petani jagung hibrida harus beli benih baru tiap musim, sedangkan padi varietas inbrida (bukan hibrida) seperti Inpari masih bisa disisihkan sebagian untuk benih musim berikutnya.
segments.tr: That is the reason hybrid corn farmers must buy new seeds every season, whereas inbred rice varieties (non-hybrid) like Inpari can still have a portion set aside for the next season's seeds.

segments.src: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bayangkan Pak Yanto, petani padi 1,2 hektar di Klaten, Jawa Tengah.
segments.tr: Imagine Mr. Yanto, a 1.2-hectare rice farmer in Klaten, Central Java.

segments.src: Selama ini ia menanam varietas unggul yang benihnya ia beli sekitar Rp 15.000–20.000 per kilogram di kios pertanian, sekitar 25 kg per hektar.
segments.tr: He has been planting superior varieties whose seeds he buys for about Rp 15,000–20,000 per kilogram at agricultural kiosks, about 25 kg per hectare.

segments.src: Musim lalu hasilnya bagus, sekitar 6 ton gabah kering per hektar.
segments.tr: Last season the yield was good, about 6 tons of dry grain per hectare.

segments.src: Musim ini tetangganya di blok sebelah kena serangan wereng batang coklat cukup parah — panen mereka anjlok.
segments.tr: This season his neighbor in the next block was hit by a fairly severe brown planthopper attack — their harvest plummeted.

segments.src: Sawah Pak Yanto ikut kena, tapi lebih ringan, karena varietas yang ia tanam kebetulan membawa gen ketahanan wereng hasil persilangan yang dilakukan pemulia bertahun-tahun sebelumnya.
segments.tr: Mr. Yanto's fields were also hit, but lighter, because the variety he planted happened to carry the planthopper resistance gene resulting from crosses made by breeders years before.

segments.src: Dari mana gen itu datang?
segments.tr: Where did that gene come from?

segments.src: Sebagian gen ketahanan wereng pada padi modern berasal dari padi liar dan varietas lokal yang dulu dikumpulkan ke bank gen — tanaman yang secara hasil panen "jelek" dan tidak ada petani yang mau menanamnya, tapi menyimpan satu sifat berharga.
segments.tr: Some of the planthopper resistance genes in modern rice come from wild rice and local varieties previously collected in gene banks — plants that in terms of harvest yield were "poor" and no farmers wanted to plant them, but stored one valuable trait.

segments.src: Pemulia menyilangkannya dengan varietas berdaya hasil tinggi, lalu selama banyak generasi menyeleksi keturunan yang hasilnya tetap tinggi *dan* tahan wereng.
segments.tr: Breeders crossed them with high-yielding varieties, then over many generations selected offspring that remained high-yielding *and* planthopper resistant.

segments.src: Di pojok lumbungnya, Pak Yanto juga masih menyimpan sekarung kecil padi Rojolele warisan bapaknya.
segments.tr: In the corner of his barn, Mr. Yanto also still keeps a small sack of Rojolele rice inherited from his father.

segments.src: Hasilnya cuma sekitar 4 ton per hektar, batangnya tinggi, dan umurnya panjang — secara ekonomi kalah jauh.
segments.tr: The yield is only about 4 tons per hectare, the stalks are tall, and the growth duration is long — economically far losing.

segments.src: Tapi aromanya khas dan pasar beras premium mau membayar lebih mahal per kilogram.
segments.tr: But the aroma is distinctive and the premium rice market is willing to pay more per kilogram.

segments.src: Tanpa sadar, Pak Yanto sedang melakukan konservasi on-farm: menjaga satu set gen aroma yang suatu hari mungkin dibutuhkan pemulia untuk merakit varietas baru yang hasilnya tinggi sekaligus wangi.
segments.tr: Unknowingly, Mr. Yanto is doing on-farm conservation: maintaining a set of aroma genes that one day breeders might need to assemble a new variety that is high-yielding and fragrant at the same time.

segments.src: Hal yang sama berlaku di luar padi.
segments.tr: The same thing applies outside of rice.

segments.src: Mangga Gedong Gincu dari Cirebon, salak Pondoh dari Sleman, durian Petruk dari Jepara, atau kentang Granola yang jadi bahan keripik — semuanya adalah varietas hasil seleksi dan pemuliaan bertahun-tahun, bukan tanaman yang tumbuh liar begitu saja.
segments.tr: Gedong Gincu mangoes from Cirebon, Pondoh snake fruit from Sleman, Petruk durian from Jepara, or Granola potatoes used for chips — all of them are varieties resulting from years of selection and breeding, not plants that grew wildly by themselves.

segments.src: ## 3 Poin Ringkas
segments.tr: ## 3 Concise Points

segments.src: 1. **Pemuliaan tanaman = ciptakan keragaman, lalu seleksi.** Persilangan (hibridisasi) menggabungkan sifat dua induk; seleksi memilih keturunan terbaik dan mengulanginya selama banyak generasi sampai sifatnya stabil.
segments.tr: 1. **Plant breeding = create diversity, then select.** Crossing (hybridization) combines the traits of two parents; selection chooses the best offspring and repeats it over many generations until the traits are stable.

segments.src: 2. **Kalau keragaman sudah ada di populasi, cukup seleksi saja** — inilah pemuliaan seleksi, yang banyak dipakai untuk memurnikan varietas lokal.
segments.tr: 2. **If diversity already exists in the population, just select** — this is selection breeding, widely used to purify local varieties.

segments.src: 3. **Tanpa koleksi plasma nutfah, pemuliaan berhenti.** Bank gen (ex situ) dan petani yang terus menanam varietas lokal (in situ/on-farm) menjaga bahan baku genetik agar tidak hilang karena erosi genetik.
segments.tr: 3. **Without germplasm collections, breeding stops.** Gene banks (ex situ) and farmers who continue to grow local varieties (in situ/on-farm) maintain genetic raw materials so they are not lost due to genetic erosion.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Seorang pemulia ingin menggabungkan sifat "hasil tinggi" dari varietas A dengan sifat "tahan kekeringan" dari varietas B.
segments.tr: **1.** A breeder wants to combine the "high yield" trait from variety A with the "drought resistance" trait from variety B.

segments.src: Metode utama yang paling tepat adalah:
segments.tr: The most appropriate main method is:

segments.src: - (a) Seleksi murni pada varietas A saja
segments.tr: - (a) Pure selection on variety A only

segments.src: - (b) Persilangan (hibridisasi) antara A dan B, dilanjutkan seleksi pada keturunannya
segments.tr: - (b) Crossing (hybridization) between A and B, followed by selection on the offspring

segments.src: - (c) Menanam A dan B berselang-seling di lahan yang sama
segments.tr: - (c) Planting A and B alternately in the same land

segments.src: - (d) Menyimpan benih A dan B di bank gen
segments.tr: - (d) Storing seeds of A and B in a gene bank

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Benih hasil panen dari tanaman jagung hibrida bisa ditanam ulang musim berikutnya dan hasilnya akan tetap sama seperti musim pertama.
segments.tr: **2.** (T/F) Harvest seeds from hybrid corn plants can be replanted the next season and the results will remain the same as the first season.

segments.src: **3.** Menyimpan benih varietas lokal di bank gen bersuhu sekitar -18 °C termasuk jenis konservasi:
segments.tr: **3.** Storing local variety seeds in a gene bank at a temperature of around -18 °C falls under the type of conservation:

segments.src: - (a) In situ
segments.tr: - (a) In situ

segments.src: - (b) On-farm
segments.tr: - (b) On-farm

segments.src: - (c) Ex situ
segments.tr: - (c) Ex situ

segments.src: - (d) Heterosis
segments.tr: - (d) Heterosis

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Term

segments.src: - **Pemuliaan tanaman (plant breeding)**: usaha terencana mengubah susunan genetik tanaman agar menghasilkan varietas dengan sifat yang lebih unggul.
segments.tr: - **Plant breeding**: planned effort to alter the genetic makeup of plants to produce varieties with superior traits.

segments.src: - **Hibridisasi (persilangan)**: penyerbukan terkendali antara dua tetua berbeda untuk menciptakan keturunan dengan kombinasi gen baru.
segments.tr: - **Hybridization (crossing)**: controlled pollination between two different parents to create offspring with new gene combinations.

segments.src: - **Seleksi**: proses memilih dan menyimpan individu bersifat unggul dari suatu populasi, lalu membuang sisanya, diulang tiap generasi.
segments.tr: - **Selection**: the process of choosing and saving individuals with superior traits from a population, then discarding the rest, repeated each generation.

segments.src: - **Plasma nutfah (sumber daya genetik)**: kumpulan bahan genetik tanaman — varietas lokal, varietas lama, dan kerabat liar — yang menjadi bahan baku pemuliaan.
segments.tr: - **Germplasm (genetic resources)**: a collection of plant genetic materials — local varieties, old varieties, and wild relatives — which become the raw material for breeding.

segments.src: - **Heterosis (hybrid vigor)**: gejala keturunan F1 dari dua galur murni menunjukkan performa lebih baik daripada kedua induknya; keunggulan ini tidak bertahan di generasi berikutnya.
segments.tr: - **Heterosis (hybrid vigor)**: the phenomenon where F1 offspring from two pure lines show better performance than both parents; this advantage does not persist in the next generation.

segments.src: *Jawaban: **1 → (b).** Karena sifat yang diinginkan tersebar di dua varietas berbeda, keduanya harus digabungkan lebih dulu lewat persilangan; seleksi saja pada satu varietas tidak bisa memunculkan gen yang memang tidak ada di dalamnya.
segments.tr: *Answer: **1 → (b).** Because the desired traits are spread across two different varieties, both must be combined first through crossing; selection alone on one variety cannot bring out genes that are not actually in it.

segments.src: **2 → X (salah).** Keunggulan hibrida hanya muncul di generasi F1.
segments.tr: **2 → F (false).** Hybrid advantages only appear in the F1 generation.

segments.src: Di generasi berikutnya (F2) sifat-sifatnya terpecah dan tidak seragam, sehingga hasilnya turun — itulah sebabnya benih jagung hibrida perlu dibeli tiap musim.
segments.tr: In the next generation (F2) the traits break apart and are not uniform, so the yield drops — that is why hybrid corn seeds need to be bought every season.

segments.src: **3 → (c) Ex situ**, karena benih disimpan di luar habitat aslinya.
segments.tr: **3 → (c) Ex situ**, because seeds are stored outside their natural habitat.

segments.src: Kalau petani terus menanam varietas lokal di sawahnya sendiri, itu baru disebut in situ / on-farm.*
segments.tr: If farmers continue to grow local varieties in their own fields, that is called in situ / on-farm.*

id-20260827-news-1.title: JCI Plunges to the 6,400 Level, Rupiah Weakens Slightly Ahead of August 27 Action: Investors Choose to Wait and See

segments.src: ## IHSG Tertekan Aksi Ambil Untung
segments.tr: ## JCI Pressured by Profit-Taking

segments.src: Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) ditutup melemah signifikan pada perdagangan Rabu (26/8), setelah investor ramai-ramai melakukan aksi profit taking di sejumlah saham unggulan.
segments.tr: The Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) closed significantly lower in Wednesday's trading (26/8), after investors heavily engaged in profit-taking across several blue-chip stocks.

segments.src: Berdasarkan data perdagangan, IHSG anjlok 95,98 poin atau sekitar 1,48 persen ke level 6.405, melanjutkan tren pelemahan yang mulai terlihat sejak sesi pertama.
segments.tr: Based on trading data, the JCI plummeted 95.98 points or about 1.48 percent to the 6,405 level, continuing the downward trend that began to appear since the first session.

segments.src: Pelemahan ini terjadi setelah IHSG sempat mencatatkan kenaikan dalam beberapa hari perdagangan sebelumnya, sehingga banyak pelaku pasar memanfaatkan momentum tersebut untuk merealisasikan keuntungan (profit taking).
segments.tr: This decline occurred after the JCI had recorded increases in several previous trading days, leading many market participants to take advantage of the momentum to realize gains (profit-taking).

segments.src: Aksi jual yang masif membuat mayoritas sektor saham bergerak di zona merah, dengan tekanan jual terpantau merata di berbagai lini industri.
segments.tr: The massive selling action caused the majority of stock sectors to move into the red zone, with selling pressure observed evenly across various industrial lines.

segments.src: ## Rupiah Ikut Melemah Tipis
segments.tr: ## Rupiah Also Weakens Slightly

segments.src: Sejalan dengan pergerakan IHSG, nilai tukar rupiah terhadap dolar Amerika Serikat (AS) juga mengalami pelemahan tipis.
segments.tr: In line with the JCI movement, the rupiah exchange rate against the US dollar (USD) also experienced a slight weakening.

segments.src: Rupiah tercatat berada di level Rp17.725 per dolar AS, turun dibandingkan posisi perdagangan sebelumnya.
segments.tr: The rupiah was recorded at the level of Rp17,725 per US dollar, dropping compared to the previous trading position.

segments.src: Pelemahan ini mencerminkan sikap kehati-hatian pelaku pasar terhadap kondisi domestik maupun sentimen global yang masih berkembang.
segments.tr: This weakening reflects market participants' cautious stance toward domestic conditions and still-developing global sentiment.

segments.src: Analis pasar menilai pelemahan rupiah kali ini masih tergolong wajar dan belum mengindikasikan tekanan struktural yang berarti, mengingat besaran depresiasi yang relatif terbatas dibandingkan mata uang kawasan lainnya.
segments.tr: Market analysts assess that this rupiah decline is still considered normal and does not indicate significant structural pressure, given the relatively limited depreciation magnitude compared to other regional currencies.

segments.src: ## Faktor Kehati-hatian Menjelang Akhir Pekan
segments.tr: ## Caution Factors Ahead of the Weekend

segments.src: Selain aksi ambil untung, pelaku pasar juga tampak lebih berhati-hati menjelang beberapa agenda penting di dalam negeri, termasuk rencana penyampaian aspirasi masyarakat yang dijadwalkan berlangsung di area sekitar Gedung DPR pada 27 Agustus.
segments.tr: Aside from profit-taking, market participants also appeared more cautious ahead of several important domestic agendas, including the planned public aspirations delivery scheduled around the DPR Building area on August 27.

segments.src: Kondisi ini mendorong sebagian investor, baik domestik maupun asing, untuk mengambil sikap wait and see alias menunggu dan mengamati perkembangan situasi sebelum mengambil keputusan investasi lanjutan.
segments.tr: This condition encourages some investors, both domestic and foreign, to adopt a wait-and-see attitude, meaning to wait and observe the situation's development before making further investment decisions.

segments.src: Sikap menunggu ini merupakan hal yang lumrah terjadi di pasar modal ketika terdapat agenda nasional yang berpotensi memengaruhi persepsi risiko jangka pendek.
segments.tr: This waiting stance is a common occurrence in the capital market when there is a national agenda that has the potential to influence short-term risk perception.

segments.src: Para analis mengingatkan bahwa fluktuasi semacam ini adalah bagian normal dari dinamika pasar dan cenderung bersifat sementara, selama fundamental ekonomi domestik tetap terjaga.
segments.tr: Analysts remind that such fluctuations are a normal part of market dynamics and tend to be temporary, as long as domestic economic fundamentals remain maintained.

segments.src: ## Pandangan Analis ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Analyst Outlook Ahead

segments.src: Sejumlah analis pasar modal menyampaikan bahwa pelemahan IHSG dan rupiah dalam sepekan terakhir lebih banyak dipengaruhi oleh faktor teknikal dan sentimen jangka pendek, bukan perubahan fundamental ekonomi yang signifikan.
segments.tr: A number of capital market analysts stated that the decline in the JCI and rupiah over the past week was largely influenced by technical factors and short-term sentiment, rather than significant fundamental economic changes.

segments.src: Data makroekonomi Indonesia, seperti inflasi dan pertumbuhan ekonomi, dinilai masih berada pada jalur yang relatif stabil.
segments.tr: Indonesia's macroeconomic data, such as inflation and economic growth, are judged to still be on a relatively stable track.

segments.src: Investor disarankan untuk tetap mencermati perkembangan situasi terkini serta memperhatikan rilis data ekonomi domestik dan global dalam beberapa hari ke depan.
segments.tr: Investors are advised to continue observing the latest developments and pay attention to domestic and global economic data releases in the next few days.

segments.src: Diversifikasi portofolio dan manajemen risiko yang baik tetap menjadi kunci utama dalam menghadapi periode volatilitas pasar seperti saat ini.
segments.tr: Portfolio diversification and good risk management remain the main keys in facing market volatility periods like today.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Pelemahan IHSG ke level 6.405 dan rupiah ke Rp17.725 mencerminkan sikap kehati-hatian pasar menjelang agenda nasional pada akhir pekan.
segments.tr: The drop of the JCI to the 6,405 level and the rupiah to Rp17,725 reflects market caution ahead of the weekend's national agenda.

segments.src: Meski demikian, pelaku pasar diimbau untuk tetap tenang dan mengandalkan analisis fundamental dalam mengambil keputusan investasi, mengingat pergerakan pasar jangka pendek dapat dipengaruhi oleh berbagai faktor sentimen yang sifatnya sementara.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, market participants are urged to remain calm and rely on fundamental analysis in making investment decisions, considering that short-term market movements can be influenced by various temporary sentiment factors.

id-20260827-news-2.title: Red Bird's Eye Chili Prices Hit Rp64,100 per Kg, Highest This Month Ahead of Late August

segments.src: ## Harga Cabai Rawit Merah Catat Level Tertinggi Bulan Ini
segments.tr: ## Red Bird's Eye Chili Prices Record Highest Level This Month

segments.src: Harga cabai rawit merah di tingkat konsumen kembali menjadi sorotan menjelang akhir Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: The price of red bird's eye chili at the consumer level is once again in the spotlight ahead of late August 2026.

segments.src: Berdasarkan data Pusat Informasi Harga Pangan Strategis (PIHPS) Bank Indonesia per 26 Agustus 2026, harga rata-rata nasional komoditas ini tercatat menyentuh Rp64.100 per kilogram, level tertinggi sepanjang bulan berjalan.
segments.tr: Based on data from Bank Indonesia's Strategic Food Price Information Center (PIHPS) as of August 26, 2026, the national average price of this commodity was recorded at Rp64.100 per kilogram, the highest level throughout the current month.

segments.src: Kenaikan ini menambah daftar panjang komoditas pangan yang harganya bergerak naik dalam beberapa pekan terakhir.
segments.tr: This increase adds to the long list of food commodities whose prices have trended upward in recent weeks.

segments.src: Selain cabai rawit merah, data yang sama juga mencatat tren kenaikan pada harga beras dan minyak goreng, dua kebutuhan pokok yang porsinya cukup besar dalam belanja bulanan rumah tangga.
segments.tr: In addition to red bird's eye chili, the same data also records an upward trend in the prices of rice and cooking oil, two basic necessities that make up a sizable portion of household monthly spending.

segments.src: ## Tren Kenaikan yang Kompak
segments.tr: ## A Uniform Upward Trend

segments.src: Menariknya, kenaikan kali ini tidak terjadi pada satu komoditas saja, melainkan berbarengan dengan sejumlah bahan pangan strategis lainnya.
segments.tr: Interestingly, this increase did not occur in just a single commodity, but coincided with several other strategic food ingredients.

segments.src: Berikut gambaran umum tren yang tercermin dari data PIHPS menjelang pergantian bulan:
segments.tr: Here is an overview of the trend reflected in PIHPS data ahead of the turn of the month:

segments.src: - **Cabai rawit merah** — menembus rekor bulanan di kisaran Rp64.100 per kg, melanjutkan tren kenaikan bertahap sejak pertengahan Agustus.
segments.tr: - **Red bird's eye chili** — breaking monthly records around Rp64.100 per kg, continuing the gradual upward trend since mid-August.

segments.src: - **Beras** — harga rata-rata nasional ikut bergerak naik, meski dengan laju yang relatif lebih landai dibanding komoditas hortikultura seperti cabai.
segments.tr: - **Rice** — the national average price also moved upward, albeit at a relatively slower pace compared to horticultural commodities like chili.

segments.src: - **Minyak goreng** — turut mencatat kenaikan tipis, menambah tekanan pada pos belanja dapur rumah tangga.
segments.tr: - **Cooking oil** — also recorded a slight increase, adding pressure on household kitchen spending items.

segments.src: Pergerakan harga cabai umumnya memang lebih fluktuatif dibandingkan komoditas pangan pokok lain, karena sangat dipengaruhi oleh faktor musiman, cuaca di sentra produksi, serta rantai distribusi dari petani hingga pasar tradisional maupun modern.
segments.tr: Chili price movements are generally more volatile compared to other staple food commodities because they are heavily influenced by seasonal factors, weather in production centers, and distribution chains from farmers to traditional and modern markets.

segments.src: ## Faktor yang Diperkirakan Memengaruhi Harga
segments.tr: ## Factors Estimated to Influence Prices

segments.src: Secara umum, kenaikan harga cabai rawit merah menjelang akhir bulan sering dikaitkan dengan beberapa faktor musiman yang berulang setiap tahun, di antaranya:
segments.tr: In general, the increase in red bird's eye chili prices towards the end of the month is often associated with several seasonal factors that recur every year, including:

segments.src: 1. **Pergeseran musim tanam** di sejumlah sentra produksi yang dapat memengaruhi volume panen dalam jangka pendek.
segments.tr: 1. **Shifts in the planting season** in a number of production centers which can affect harvest volume in the short term.

segments.src: 2. **Kondisi cuaca** yang tidak menentu, sehingga berdampak pada kualitas dan kuantitas hasil panen cabai.
segments.tr: 2. **Uncertain weather conditions**, impacting the quality and quantity of chili harvests.

segments.src: 3. **Biaya distribusi dan logistik** dari daerah sentra ke pasar-pasar besar di kota, yang turut memengaruhi harga jual akhir ke konsumen.
segments.tr: 3. **Distribution and logistics costs** from production regions to major city markets, which also affect the final selling price to consumers.

segments.src: 4. **Pola permintaan musiman**, termasuk kebutuhan rumah tangga dan sektor kuliner yang relatif stabil namun sensitif terhadap pasokan.
segments.tr: 4. **Seasonal demand patterns**, including household and culinary sector needs that remain relatively stable yet sensitive to supply.

segments.src: Perlu dicatat bahwa data PIHPS bersifat indikatif dan merupakan rata-rata harga dari berbagai pasar yang dipantau di sejumlah daerah, sehingga harga aktual di lapangan dapat bervariasi antar wilayah maupun antar jenis pasar.
segments.tr: It should be noted that PIHPS data is indicative and represents average prices from various monitored markets across several regions, so actual prices on the ground may vary between regions and types of markets.

segments.src: ## Dampak ke Belanja Rumah Tangga
segments.tr: ## Impact on Household Spending

segments.src: Kenaikan harga yang kompak pada cabai rawit merah, beras, dan minyak goreng berpotensi menambah beban pengeluaran rumah tangga, khususnya menjelang pergantian bulan saat banyak keluarga menyusun kembali anggaran belanja bulanan.
segments.tr: The uniform price increase in red bird's eye chili, rice, and cooking oil has the potential to add to the burden of household expenditures, especially ahead of the turn of the month when many families re-evaluate their monthly shopping budgets.

segments.src: Ketiga komoditas ini termasuk dalam kelompok bahan pangan yang paling sering dikonsumsi sehari-hari, sehingga pergerakan harganya cenderung langsung terasa di dapur.
segments.tr: These three commodities belong to the group of food items most frequently consumed daily, so their price movements tend to be felt immediately in the kitchen.

segments.src: Bagi pelaku usaha kuliner skala kecil dan menengah, kenaikan harga cabai juga berpotensi memengaruhi biaya produksi, terutama bagi usaha yang mengandalkan cabai sebagai bahan baku utama seperti warung makan pedas, sambal kemasan, hingga katering rumahan.
segments.tr: For small and medium-scale culinary business operators, the increase in chili prices also has the potential to affect production costs, especially for businesses relying on chili as a primary raw material such as spicy food stalls, packaged sambal, and home catering.

segments.src: ## Tips Menyiasati Kenaikan Harga Pangan
segments.tr: ## Tips for Navigating Food Price Increases

segments.src: Menghadapi situasi harga pangan yang fluktuatif, beberapa langkah berikut dapat dipertimbangkan oleh masyarakat untuk mengelola belanja dapur dengan lebih bijak:
segments.tr: Facing volatile food price situations, the public may consider several of the following steps to manage kitchen spending more wisely:

segments.src: - Membandingkan harga di beberapa pasar atau platform belanja sebelum membeli dalam jumlah besar.
segments.tr: - Comparing prices across several markets or shopping platforms before buying in large quantities.

segments.src: - Memanfaatkan alternatif olahan cabai kering atau cabai bubuk saat harga cabai segar sedang tinggi.
segments.tr: - Utilizing dried chili or chili powder alternatives when fresh chili prices are high.

segments.src: - Menyesuaikan porsi belanja bulanan dengan memantau tren harga melalui sumber resmi seperti PIHPS Bank Indonesia atau aplikasi informasi pangan daerah.
segments.tr: - Adjusting monthly shopping portions by monitoring price trends through official sources like Bank Indonesia's PIHPS or regional food information applications.

segments.src: - Bagi pelaku usaha kuliner, mempertimbangkan variasi menu atau resep untuk menjaga margin tanpa mengurangi kualitas rasa secara signifikan.
segments.tr: - For culinary business operators, considering menu or recipe variations to maintain margins without significantly reducing taste quality.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Pergerakan harga cabai rawit merah yang tembus Rp64.100 per kg menjelang akhir Agustus 2026 ini menjadi pengingat bahwa harga pangan strategis masih rentan terhadap dinamika musiman dan distribusi.
segments.tr: The movement of red bird's eye chili prices breaking Rp64.100 per kg ahead of late August 2026 serves as a reminder that strategic food prices remain vulnerable to seasonal and distribution dynamics.

segments.src: Masyarakat disarankan untuk terus memantau perkembangan harga melalui sumber data resmi agar dapat mengambil keputusan belanja yang lebih tepat di tengah tren kenaikan harga pangan yang tampak kompak menjelang pergantian bulan.
segments.tr: The public is advised to continuously monitor price developments through official data sources in order to make more appropriate shopping decisions amid the seemingly uniform food price upward trend ahead of the turn of the month.

segments.src: *Data harga dalam artikel ini mengacu pada informasi PIHPS Bank Indonesia per 26 Agustus 2026 dan dapat berubah sewaktu-waktu mengikuti kondisi pasar di masing-masing daerah.*
segments.tr: *Price data in this article refers to Bank Indonesia's PIHPS information as of August 26, 2026 and is subject to change at any time following market conditions in each respective region.*

id-20260827-news-3.title: Indonesian-US Reciprocal Tariff Issue Resolved, Awaiting Decision on Excess Capacity

segments.src: Pemerintah Indonesia menyatakan bahwa pembahasan terkait isu kerja paksa atau *forced labor* dalam kerangka Section 301 dengan Amerika Serikat sudah rampung.
segments.tr: The Indonesian government stated that discussions regarding the issue of forced labor under the Section 301 framework with the United States have been completed.

segments.src: Hasilnya, Indonesia dikenakan tarif sebesar 10 persen untuk kategori tersebut.
segments.tr: As a result, Indonesia is subject to a 10 percent tariff for that category.

segments.src: Meski begitu, satu ganjalan besar masih tersisa sebelum kesepakatan dagang antara kedua negara bisa diratifikasi tahun ini, yaitu isu kelebihan kapasitas produksi atau *excess capacity*.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, one major hurdle remains before the trade agreement between the two countries can be ratified this year, namely the issue of production overcapacity or *excess capacity*.

segments.src: ## Forced Labor Sudah Diselesaikan
segments.tr: ## Forced Labor Issue Resolved

segments.src: Isu kerja paksa menjadi salah satu perhatian utama Amerika Serikat dalam negosiasi dagang dengan berbagai mitra, termasuk Indonesia, karena berkaitan dengan standar ketenagakerjaan dalam rantai pasok global.
segments.tr: The forced labor issue has been one of the primary concerns of the United States in trade negotiations with various partners, including Indonesia, as it relates to labor standards in the global supply chain.

segments.src: Section 301 sendiri merupakan instrumen hukum perdagangan AS yang memungkinkan pemerintah negara tersebut mengenakan tindakan tarif terhadap negara mitra atas dasar praktik dagang yang dianggap tidak adil.
segments.tr: Section 301 itself is a US trade law instrument that allows its government to impose tariff measures against partner countries on the grounds of unfair trade practices.

segments.src: Menurut keterangan pemerintah, poin mengenai kerja paksa dalam pembahasan ini telah disepakati kedua belah pihak dengan hasil akhir berupa pengenaan tarif 10 persen bagi produk-produk Indonesia yang termasuk dalam cakupan pembahasan tersebut.
segments.tr: According to government statements, the point regarding forced labor in these discussions has been agreed upon by both parties, with the final outcome being the imposition of a 10 percent tariff on Indonesian products falling within the scope of the discussion.

segments.src: Penyelesaian ini disebut sebagai kemajuan penting dalam proses negosiasi tarif resiprokal yang telah berlangsung sejak beberapa waktu terakhir.
segments.tr: This resolution is termed an important milestone in the reciprocal tariff negotiation process that has been ongoing for some time.

segments.src: ## Ganjalan yang Tersisa: Kelebihan Kapasitas
segments.tr: ## Remaining Hurdle: Excess Capacity

segments.src: Meski satu isu telah tuntas, proses negosiasi belum sepenuhnya selesai.
segments.tr: Although one issue has been settled, the negotiation process is not yet fully complete.

segments.src: Pemerintah menyebut masih ada satu topik yang menjadi pekerjaan rumah bersama, yakni persoalan kelebihan kapasitas produksi di sejumlah sektor industri.
segments.tr: The government noted that there is still one topic remaining as a shared homework assignment, namely the issue of production overcapacity in a number of industrial sectors.

segments.src: Isu ini kerap muncul dalam pembicaraan dagang global, terutama menyangkut komoditas seperti baja, aluminium, hingga produk manufaktur lain yang dianggap rentan terhadap praktik banjir pasokan ke pasar internasional.
segments.tr: This issue frequently arises in global trade talks, particularly concerning commodities such as steel, aluminum, and other manufactured products considered vulnerable to supply flooding in international markets.

segments.src: Pembahasan mengenai kelebihan kapasitas ini disebut masih menunggu keputusan dari pihak Amerika Serikat.
segments.tr: Discussions regarding this excess capacity are said to still be awaiting a decision from the United States side.

segments.src: Artinya, kelanjutan sekaligus penyelesaian akhir dari kesepakatan tarif resiprokal antara Indonesia dan AS sangat bergantung pada sikap dan kebijakan yang akan diambil Washington terkait isu tersebut.
segments.tr: This means that the continuation and final conclusion of the reciprocal tariff agreement between Indonesia and the US heavily depend on the stance and policies Washington will adopt regarding the issue.

segments.src: ## Target Ratifikasi Tahun Ini
segments.tr: ## Target Ratification This Year

segments.src: Pemerintah menargetkan agar kesepakatan tarif resiprokal antara Indonesia dan Amerika Serikat dapat diratifikasi pada tahun ini.
segments.tr: The government targets the reciprocal tariff agreement between Indonesia and the United States to be ratified this year.

segments.src: Namun demikian, target tersebut baru dapat tercapai apabila seluruh poin pembahasan, termasuk isu kelebihan kapasitas, sudah mendapatkan titik temu antara kedua negara.
segments.tr: However, this target can only be achieved if all discussion points, including the excess capacity issue, find a common ground between the two countries.

segments.src: Proses negosiasi dagang semacam ini umumnya melibatkan berbagai kementerian dan lembaga terkait, mulai dari sektor perdagangan, perindustrian, hingga koordinasi kebijakan ekonomi secara lebih luas.
segments.tr: Such trade negotiation processes generally involve various relevant ministries and agencies, ranging from the trade and industrial sectors to broader economic policy coordination.

segments.src: Setiap poin yang disepakati biasanya turut mempertimbangkan dampaknya terhadap pelaku usaha dalam negeri, khususnya sektor-sektor yang selama ini menjadi andalan ekspor Indonesia ke pasar Amerika Serikat.
segments.tr: Each agreed point typically considers its impact on domestic business actors, particularly sectors that have long been the mainstay of Indonesia's exports to the United States market.

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi Pelaku Usaha
segments.tr: ## Impact on Business Actors

segments.src: Bagi kalangan pelaku usaha dan eksportir, kepastian mengenai tarif resiprokal ini menjadi hal yang dinanti-nantikan.
segments.tr: For business actors and exporters, certainty regarding this reciprocal tariff is eagerly awaited.

segments.src: Kejelasan angka tarif serta cakupan produk yang terdampak akan membantu dunia usaha dalam menyusun strategi bisnis dan daya saing produk Indonesia di pasar Amerika Serikat, terutama di tengah persaingan dengan negara-negara pengekspor lain yang juga tengah menjalani proses negosiasi serupa dengan AS.
segments.tr: Clear tariff figures and the scope of affected products will help the business world formulate business strategies and the competitiveness of Indonesian products in the US market, especially amid competition with other exporting countries currently undergoing similar negotiation processes with the US.

segments.src: Sejumlah pengamat ekonomi menilai bahwa penyelesaian bertahap seperti ini merupakan hal yang lumrah dalam negosiasi dagang antarnegara, mengingat kompleksitas isu yang dibahas serta perbedaan kepentingan dari masing-masing pihak.
segments.tr: A number of economic observers consider that gradual resolutions like this are common in intergovernmental trade negotiations, given the complexity of the issues discussed and the differing interests of each party.

segments.src: Yang terpenting, menurut mereka, adalah memastikan hasil akhir kesepakatan tetap menguntungkan bagi keberlangsungan sektor industri dan ekspor nasional.
segments.tr: Most importantly, according to them, is ensuring that the final outcome of the agreement remains beneficial for the sustainability of the national industrial and export sectors.

segments.src: ## Langkah Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## Next Steps

segments.src: Ke depan, publik akan menantikan perkembangan lebih lanjut mengenai sikap resmi Amerika Serikat terhadap isu kelebihan kapasitas.
segments.tr: Moving forward, the public will await further developments regarding the official stance of the United States on the excess capacity issue.

segments.src: Jika titik temu dapat segera dicapai, proses ratifikasi kesepakatan tarif resiprokal RI-AS berpotensi rampung sesuai target yang telah ditetapkan pemerintah pada tahun ini, sehingga memberikan kepastian yang lebih besar bagi iklim perdagangan dan investasi antara kedua negara.
segments.tr: If a common ground can be reached soon, the ratification process of the Indonesia-US reciprocal tariff agreement has the potential to be completed according to the target set by the government this year, thereby providing greater certainty for the trade and investment climate between the two countries.
